title: Setup says kilograms or pounds can be changed in Profile, but that choice is only in Settings
what: Step 2 of setup tells a new member they can change kilograms or pounds in Profile. Neither the Profile tab nor its Edit profile page has that choice; it sits in Settings, Units.
expected: The words name the place where the choice really is: Settings, Units.
who: every new member who picks the wrong unit
fix_line: Change the line to say Settings, Units.

title: The sign-in-not-open message calls the gym code a 6-letter code, but codes also hold numbers
what: When signing in by number is not open, the message says to type your gym's 6-letter code. Everywhere else the app says the code is 6 letters or numbers, and real codes can contain digits.
expected: One name for the code everywhere: 6 letters or numbers.
who: members whose phone sign-in is refused
fix_line: Say 6 letters or numbers, from the same length setting as the other lines.

title: Open Profile on the straight-in note opens the Profile tab, not the place to change goal and experience
what: The note says you can change your goal and experience in Profile and offers Open Profile. The button lands on the Profile tab, where goal and experience are not shown; the member must find the small pencil Edit profile button first.
expected: Open Profile opens the Edit profile page with goal and experience in view.
who: members joined straight in by phone number
fix_line: Point the button at the Edit profile page.
